Բարի գալուստ ARMEPS

Հայտերի նախապատրաստման գործիք

Եթե Դուք ՌԴ մասնակից եք, կարող եք փաստաթղթեր ստորագրել այս հղումով:




Հարգելի գործընկեր Ձեր գործունեության ոլորտի վերաբերյալ հայտարարվող ընթացակարգերի մասին տեղեկատվությունը էլ-փոստի միջոցով ստանալու համար անհրաժեշտ է մուտք գործել համակարգ «ՏՕ-ի տնօրինություն» բաժնում «Խմբագրել ԳԸԲ կոդերը» ենթաբաժնում ընտրել համապատասխան ոլորտները:

Առավելություններ
Մրցութային փաստաթղթերը հեշտ հասանելի են և հեշտությամբ բեռնվում են ARMEPS համակարգից:
Առգիծ ներկայացման գործընթացը շատ պարզ է, բեռնումն արագ է, և ուղարկվում է ստացման հաստատում:
Պատմության գրանցամատյանը մատակարարին տրամադրում է գործընթացին վերաբերող թարմացումներ:
Կարիք չկա փաստաթղթերի առաքումը վստահել երրորդ կողմին:
Ավելի շատ ժամանակ` պատասխանը նախապատրաստելու համար: Մրցույթի մասնակիցն էլեկտրոնային ճանապարհով ներկայացնելով փաստաթղթերը ժամանակ կտնտեսի պատասխանները լրացնելու համար:
Մատակարարներ
Բոլոր մատակարարներն, ովքեր ցանկանում են մասնակցել` պետք է գրանցվեն ARMEPS-ում:

Այս համակարգը տրամադրում է գնային առաջարկները էլեկտրոնային տարբերակով լրացնելու և ներկայացնելու ապահով մեթոդ:
Գրանցվել իբրև մատակարար
Կարևոր է - Խնդրեմ ի նկատի ունենալ, որ բաց մրցույթների վերաբերվող փաստաթղթերը դիտելու համար մատակարարները կարիք չունեն արտահայտել իրենց հետաքրքրվածությունը, այնուհանդերձ, եղեք տեղեկացված, որ բաց գնումներին վերաբերող տեղեկություններ ստանալու համար մատակարարը ՊԵՏՔ է արտահայտի իր հետաքրքրվածությունը բաշխումների ցուցակում ներգրավվելու համար: Եթե մատակարարը մրցույթի նկատմամբ հետաքրքրություն չի ցուցաբերել, ապա մրցութային հաղորդակցություններից վերջինիս դուրս մնալու համար գնորդը պատասխանատու չէ:

Por último, podrán acceder al portal de Autogestión de proveedores para consultar sobre el estado de sus facturas.

Congratulations and welcome to the Drupal community.

Drupal is an open source platform for building amazing digital experiences. It’s made, used, taught, documented, and marketed by the Drupal community. Our community is made up of people from around the world with a shared set of values, collaborating together in a respectful manner. As we like to say:

Come for the code, stay for the community.
Get Started

There are a few ways to get started with Drupal:

User Guide: Includes installing, administering, site building, and maintaining the content of a Drupal website.
Create Content: Want to get right to work? Start adding content. Note: the information on this page will go away once you add content to your site. Read on and bookmark resources of interest.
Extend Drupal: Drupal’s core software can be extended and customized in remarkable ways. Install additional functionality and change the look of your site using addons contributed by our community.
Next Steps

Bookmark these links to our active Drupal community groups and support resources.

Upcoming Events: Learn and connect with others at conferences and events held around the world.
Community Page: List of key Drupal community groups with their own content.
Get support and chat with the Drupal community on Slack or DrupalChat. When you’re looking for a solution to a problem, go to Drupal Support or Drupal Answers on Stack Exchange.

User Registration Steps
Steps to register with the e-GP System
BEFORE YOU START : Basic requirement from user side
Computer with one of the BPPA certified browsers ((Microsoft Edge 109.x or above and Mozilla Firefox 113.x or above and Google Chrome 109.x or above)
Internet connectivity with appropriate bandwidth level
Valid e-mail account
STEPS FOR USER REGISTRATION
Please type www.eprocure.gov.bd in the address bar using one of the BPPA certified web browsers (list of Browsers are available at https://www.eprocure.gov.bd/SupportingBrowser.jsp ) and click "Enter".
e-GP website will be opened. Then click the "New User Registration" button below the log-in box in the left hand side menu.
A new webpage "New User Registration - Login Account Details" will open.
Click "Submit" button after entering user details including the verification code (CAPTCHA), and click the check box at the end of the form for accepting the Terms and Conditions.
Now you will receive an e-mail with Verification Code in your own e-mail account which you have provided for registering into the e-GP System.
Open the e-mail you received from e-GP System, and click on the link provided in the e-mail. It will open a page in e-GP website for e-mail verification.
Along with other details, enter the Verification Code you received in e-mail sent to you by e-GP System. If the verification code matches, then your e-mail account is verified.
You will receive another e-mail from e-GP System with further actions to be taken by you with a list of mandatory documents for scanning and uploading to e-GP System.
Before uploading documents, print the e-mail you have received and go to e-GP Member bank to pay a registration fee of BDT 5000/- (Bangladesh Taka Five Thousand Only) [Registration fee for International Tenderers is BDT 12000/- (Bangladesh Taka Twelve Thousand Only)].
After paying the registration fee through bank, login to e-GP System using your login information and upload all the scanned mandatory documents including registration fee payment slip.
Get a photocopy of all mandatory documents attested by a Class-I Government Official and send to BPPA for physical verification through mail post or courier.
Once the attested documents and uploaded documents are verified in the BPPA, you will get e-mail with your User Registration Approval information.
Now you can login to e-GP system and start using the system to participate in e-Tendering process.

Welcome to the Belgian e-Procurement platform, provided by the Federal Public Service Policy and Support. Our platform is designed to make public procurement in Belgium more efficient, transparent, and accessible to all.

As a contracting authority, you can use our platform to easily manage your procurement processes online, including publishing tender notices and inviting suppliers to submit a tender directly. You can also search for and contact registered suppliers to request a bid for contracts that are not published. As a supplier, you can access all current and upcoming public procurement opportunities in Belgium, and submit your bids electronically through our platform. You can also register your business cards on our platform, making it easier for contracting authorities to directly find and contact you for relevant contracts.

Our platform is free and open to any Belgian contracting authority and any supplier who is interested in Belgian public procurement contracts. Portal Nacional de Contratações Públicas - PNCP
Portal Nacional de Contratações Públicas - PNCP

Este é o sítio oficial em que estão publicadas informações sobre as contratações públicas, criado por uma determinação da Nova Lei de Licitações e Contratos Administrativos (Lei nº 14.133/2021) para manter a transparência.

O PNCP é administrado pelo Comitê Gestor da Rede Nacional de Contratações Públicas e garante que os dados de todas as contratações feitas pela União e por governos estaduais e municipais estarão centralizados aqui e disponíveis a todos. É importante destacar que o fornecimento dessas informações é de responsabilidade dos órgãos e entidades que realizam contratos ou compras para a manutenção dos serviços públicos.

O que você pode fazer aqui: 

Pesquisar por Planos de Contratações Anuais (PCA), Editais, Avisos de Contratação, Atas de Registro de Preços e Contratos;

Integrar seu sistema ou plataforma de contratações ao PNCP;


Encontrar material informativo para saber mais, e;


Conhecer os documentos já padronizados para adquirir alguns itens que os órgãos e entidades públicas compram com frequência.

Buy Canadian Policy

The Government of Canada has introduced new policies to protect, build, and transform Canadian industries. Check out Buy Canadian Policy for more information on what this could mean for you.

How to register your business

Before you can start bidding on tender opportunities posted by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC), you will need to register your business.

 

PSPC buys goods and services on behalf of other federal departments and agencies and Crown corporations. To do this, PSPC uses SAP Business Network, a web-based tool that allows businesses to view and bid on opportunities.

Get your SAP Business Network account

Registering and completing your company profile in advance will save you time and let you focus on preparing your bid when the time comes. To help you with creating your account:

consult our registration checklist on what you need before registering
read our step-by-step guide on how to register for a free account
call, email or chat with our Service Desk if you have questions

CREATE YOUR SAP BUSINESS NETWORK ACCOUNT

If you do not represent a business but want to view tender opportunities, you will still need to register for an account.

Already have an account?

Millions of companies around the world use SAP Business Network, so your business may already have an account. Unsure if your business already has an account? The system will notify you if there are any duplicates after you fill out and submit the registration form.

If you have an account, you will still need to answer a few additional questions about your business to view and bid on tender opportunities. Log in to SAP Business Network and complete your company profile.

LOG IN TO SAP BUSINESS NETWORK

Complete the questionnaire

Once you have created your SAP Business Network account and have your business number you will need to fill out the Government of Canada’s required questionnaire before you can submit a bid. 

>  Follow the instructions on how to complete the questions

Get a CRA business number

Businesses of all sizes, no matter their location, wanting to sell goods or services to the Government of Canada will need a Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) business number. 

It is encouraged that you enter your CRA business number when registering with SAP Business Network, as you will need it if you win a contract.

For Canadian businesses: Register for a CRA business number
For businesses outside of Canada: Register for a non-resident CRA business number

Bids Homepage   Find more bids   Create Account  Login
Welcome to the Government of Yukon Bid Opportunities Website

 

This site allows businesses interested in bidding on Government of Yukon contracts to create a vendor account.  When creating your account, select the commodity codes relevant to your business to receive email notifications about bid opportunities that match the commodity codes you have selected.


The Bid Details page contains information including Meeting Locations, Procurement Authority contact details, Plan Takers, Bids Summary and Award Summary. Please note, procurement documents may be secured and you will be required to register for the bid to download and view the documents, as well as some additional details. There is no cost to obtain an unsecured version of the document and/or to participate in this solicitation. A FREE account can be made by using the “Create Account” button below. All the same information prior to this update is available publicly once you have logged into an account

Businesses are solely responsible for ensuring their vendor account information is accurate and up to date.

 

Vendor resources:

Please visit the support portal for written guides on topics including how to create and manage your account and how to submit an online submission.

Please visit YG Learn to view tutorial videos on how to set up an account and how to submit an online submission.

 

Yukon First Nation Business Registry Inquiries:

Please be advised that all inquiries, updates, and submissions related to the Yukon First Nation Business Registry (YFNBR) must be directed to:

Email: Contracts@yukon.ca or Phone: 867‑667‑5385

Please include “YFNBR” in the subject line to ensure your email is directed to the appropriate person.

Subject line format:  YFNBR – [Business name / brief description]"

 

Questions? If you have questions about a specific bid opportunity, please Submit a Question through the system in order to direct your inquiry to the contact person listed in the bid document.

If you have general questions about how Government of Yukon performs procurement, please contact the Procurement Support Centre at 867-667-5385 or email contracts@yukon.ca

If you encounter technical issues, please contact support@bidsandtenders.ca

 

Bid opportunities

Government of Yukon bid opportunities are listed below. Please refer to the Status column in the list to determine if the bid is open, closed or awarded.

Since August 18th, 2020, all Government of Yukon public bid opportunities issued were posted on this site. Opportunities released prior to this date can be found on the Tender Management System.

The procurement platform of the public sector

Welcome to simap.ch, the procurement platform of the Swiss Confederation and government-associated organisations, cantons and communes in Switzerland. Here you can find current and completed invitations to tender issued under public procurement law.

As company, you are able

to search manually for invitations to tender or create search-request subscriptions
to download publications and the related tender documentation
to submit your questions about an invitation to tender
to submit your tenders online

As procurement office, you are able

to publish your invitations to tender and the related tender documentation
to answer questions posed by interested tenderers
to publish the award
to use the role «project member» to give access for external, mandated collaborators to individual projects
to create and export statistics

Publications issued before 1 July 2024 and their associated publications (e.g. award, correction, etc.) can be found in the archive.

“军采平台”重要通知

【临时维护通知】根据临时维护工作安排，军队采购网拟于 8月19日22:00 至 8月20日8:00 临时停机维护，期间门户网站及系统功能无法使用，请各单位合理安排采购活动，带来不便敬请谅解。

【通知】根据相关要求，军队评审专家注册系统暂停服务，暂不受理评审专家注册、入库审核等工作，客服电话010-21728181。

军队采购网现面向审价专家提供业务咨询渠道。已注册专家可通过内网门户网站右侧“服务中心-意见反馈”栏目在线提交咨询问题；未注册专家可通过外网门户网站点击右侧“在线客服”图标，或“服务中心-在线客服”栏目在线提交咨询问题。也可以通过邮箱留言反馈，邮箱地址为cgptgys@163.com。

关于明确军采平台CA申领审核时效及相关注意事项的通知

为保障供应商顺利参加军队采购活动，规范平台CA申领和审核秩序，现将CA申领审核时效及相关注意事项通知如下：


        1.目前军队采购网电子招投标系统仅支持CA办理投标业务，凡有意向参加军队采购网电子采购项目的供应商，应尽早通过“军队采购APP”提交CA申领审核，避免因未及时申领CA导致无法电子签章，影响采购文件的编制和投标。

       2.凡通过“军队采购APP”提交的CA申领及退回修改后再重新提交的，审核机构均在5个工作日内完成审核及制章。若因供应商提交的资料不符且未及时修改、CA到期未主动申请延期等原因未及时完成CA申领，造成供应商无法正常参加采购活动的，由供应商自行承担相应责任。

       3.凡通过“军队采购APP”申领CA的供应商，应按要求提交审核资料（参考“军采平台”供应商CA注册提交资料 注意事项及CA审核标准），避免因资料不清晰、缺项、漏项导致审核退回，影响审核进度。

       4.供应商须重点关注5项审核要求：

一是应上传清晰、无水印、无涂改、无反光、无遮挡的彩色证件扫描件（含营业执照和法人身份证件）。二是“注册资本”填写项应当与营业执照完全一致，注意区分汉字大、小写和数字。如：营业执照注册资本显示为“壹佰万圆整”，供应商填写时应填写“壹佰万圆整”，不可输入“一百万”或“100万元”。三是应在机构数字申请表的申请声明框中加盖单位公章。四是应在机构数字申请表的印章采集区空白处手写企业公章号。五是应在CA到期前1个月内通过APP提交延期申请，待审核通过后自动延期。 

5.目前，CA办理过程中不会向供应商收取任何费用。若有单位或个人借CA办理审核等事项收取费用，请将相关线索反馈平台邮箱（cgptgys@163.com）

Which notices are you looking for?
​
Here you can find
public tenders online!

Welcome to the Publication Service, the central portal for searching for notices of public contracting authorities from the Federal Government, the Länder and local authorities! Our Publication Service is freely accessible and offers extensive functions for your individual search in notices and associated lots.

By logging in via an ELSTER company account, you can remember notices as well as search templates and forward them to your colleagues. Let the Publication Service work for you independently and get to know at an early stage about attractive contract notices or latest information on calls for tenders that are of interest to you.

See details of calls for tenders, including the related lots, at a glance. Participate in the award procedure as before - according to the instructions of the procurement platform, which is directly linked on the respective details page.

Would you like to analyse procurement data independently? The integrated data service allows you to use the Open Data interface or to integrate notices into your own applications via the standardised Peppol infrastructure.

NEWS
07/30/2026
NEWS IN THE PUBLICATION SERVICE
Reports to the procurement statistics system can now be submitted without administrative effort

A welcome simplification for public contracting authorities: once a procurement notice has been submitted to the Data Service for Public Procurement in Germany, the statistical reports required under the Procurement Statistics Ordinance (VergStatVO) no longer need to be generated separately.

This contribution to reducing red tape is provided by the Procurement Statistics Service, which the Procurement Office of the Federal Ministry of the Interior (BMI) launched in late July 2026. It is available to all procurement platform providers for integration into their systems and can already be used by all contracting authorities that utilize theRedaktionssystem

Procurement platform providers can find all the necessary information atSelf-Service-Portal des Datenservice Öffentlicher Einkauf
06/30/2026
NEW FEATURES IN THE PUBLICATION SERVICE
An updated version of the publication service has been available since 30 June 2026.

The new features include:
Expansion of the procurement law framework search filter to include 'Divergent administrative regulations on facilitations for start-ups in public procurement' (AVV Bund Start-up)
Additional display of the number of active notices in the "Facts & Figures" section on the homepage
Stability improvements and bug fixes
04/29/2026
NEW FEATURES IN THE PUBLICATION SERVICE

Revised layout of the detail page for contract award and result notices

Registrierung

Um an Vergabeverfahren teilnehmen zu können, bitten wir Sie, sich zu registrieren. Dafür werden Sie weitergeleitet zu der externen Seite iTWO tender, dem Portal von der Firma RIB Software AG.

Registrieren

Die EU-Richtlinie 24/2014 fordert die barrierefreie Bereitstellung der Vergabeunterlagen (Ausschreibungsunterlagen, Fragen- und Antwortenkataloge, Änderungspakete) für Sie als Wirtschaftsteilnehmer. Wir stellen Ihnen daher diese Unterlagen auf unserer Vergabeplattform zur Verfügung.

Sofern Sie noch nicht registriert sind, müssen Sie sich laufend selbständig über Änderungen oder Ergänzungen zum Vergabeverfahren informieren. Diese Recherche liegt allein in Ihrer Verantwortung. Wir empfehlen Ihnen daher dringend die kostenlose Registrierung, um Formfehler zu vermeiden, die eventuell zu Ihrem Ausschluss aus dem Vergabeverfahren führen könnten. Bitte verzichten Sie darauf, sich als Unternehmen mehrfach zu registrieren, da Sie sonst mit Komplikationen beim Herunterladen der Vergabeunterlagen rechnen müssen. 

Hinterlegen Sie bitte bei der Registrierung ein sogenanntes Funktionspostfach (Beispiel: info@musterfirma.de) mit den entsprechenden Zugriffsrechten für Ihre Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter bzw. Abteilung und keine persönlichen E-Mail-Adressen (Beispiel: max.mustermann@musterfirma.de). Damit ist u. a. auch gewährleistet, dass Sie bei geplanten oder ungeplanten Abwesenheiten Zugriff auf die Vergabeunterlagen haben. Bei Fragen  stehen wir gern zur Verfügung.

Für bereits registrierte Wirtschaftsteilnehmer ändert sich der Prozessablauf nicht.

ZENTRALE UND KOSTENLOSE RECHERCHE
NACH HESSISCHEN AUSSCHREIBUNGEN
Innovativ und Effizient

Die Hessische Ausschreibungsdatenbank (HAD) ist eine internetgestützte, allgemein verfügbare Datenbank zur Veröffentlichung von Bekanntmachungen im Rahmen öffentlicher Beschaffungsverfahren. Sie wird im Interesse der gewerblichen Wirtschaft, des Handwerks und Freischaffender in Hessen betrieben, um Beschaffungsvorgänge der öffentlichen Hand mit mehr Wettbewerb, Transparenz und Effizienz auszustatten.

Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit zwischen Ministerien, Wirtschaft und Beschaffungsstellen wird die HAD ständig praxisnah weiterentwickelt. Die HAD ist nicht nur Bekanntmachungsplattform, sondern kostenloser Ansprechpartner für alle technischen, inhaltlichen und rechtlichen Fragen zum Vergabeverfahren.

Die HAD wurde Ende der 90er Jahre von der ABSt Hessen e. V. aus einer Beteiligung an dem EG-Projekt "Simap-Vergabeplattform" entwickelt. Das EG-Projekt wurde nach Einstellung durch die Europäische Kommission von der ABSt Hessen e.V. als Projekt für das Land Hessen weitergeführt. Seit 2007 ist die HAD eine kostenlose Serviceleistung für alle hessischen Vergabestellen und Unternehmen in Europa. Da per Hessischem Vergabe- und Tariftreuegesetz die Pflicht zur Veröffentlichung aller nationalen und EU-weiten Bekanntmachungen auf der HAD besteht, sind alle hessischen Bekanntmachungen vollständig auf der HAD zu finden. Weiterhin werden wichtige Vergaberegelungen, sei es Richtlinien, Gesetze oder Erlasse und sonstige Rundschreiben zum Vergaberecht insbesondere für die hessische Verwaltung tagesaktuell auf der HAD veröffentlicht. Die HAD wird daher auch vom hessischen Wirtschaftsministerium durch einen jährlichen Zuschuss unterstützt.

Für die Registrierung Ihres Unternehmens benötigen wir von Ihnen einige Daten. Dies ist notwendig, um die Sicherheit der Transaktionen zu gewährleisten und Vertrauen in den Marktplatz zu schaffen. Beachten Sie bitte auch, dass es sich bei der Registrierung um die Registrierung eines gesamten Unternehmens (mit einem Hauptnutzer) handelt. Das Anlegen von weiteren Nutzern aus Ihrem Unternehmen erfolgt nach erfolgreicher Anmeldung eigenständig durch den Hauptnutzer.

Die Registrierung erfolgt in drei Schritten:

Ausfüllen des Anmeldeformulars: Füllen Sie bitte das nachfolgende Anmeldeformular möglichst vollständig aus. Beachten Sie dabei bitte, dass die mit * markierten Felder unbedingt ausgefüllt werden müssen, damit wir Ihre Anmeldung bearbeiten können.


E-Mail-Bestätigung: Nach Prüfung der Daten erhalten Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Link für die initiale Anmeldung am System.


Initiale Anmeldung: Im Rahmen der Anmeldung werden Sie darum gebeten ein Passwort zu setzen. Sie können anschließend alle Funktionen des Marktplatzes nutzen und ggf. auch weitere Benutzer aus Ihrem Unternehmen anlegen.

observed.head:
Kontrast
Bitte Cookies aktivieren

Um diese Anwendung nutzen zu können, müssen Sie Cookies aktivieren. Ändern sie hierzu die entsprechenden Einstellungen in Ihrem Browser (Hilfestellung hierzu erhalten Sie über Dokumentation oder die Hilfefunktion).

Warum müssen Sie Cookies aktivieren?

Cookies werden benötigt, um den Besucher zu identifizieren, wenn er verschiedene Dokumente dieser Anwendung ansehen will. Ihre genaue Internet -Adresse kann nicht übertragen werden. Darum ist eine Identifikation nur möglich, wenn Ihnen ein eindeutiger Schlüssel zugewiesen wird, der immer wieder ausgelesen werden kann.

Was sind Cookies?

Ein Cookie ist eine kleine Textdateien mit Informationen, die vom Browser auf der Festplatte des Besuchers abgelegt wird. Die Datei enthält den Namen der Website oder des Servers , von wo aus der Cookie verschickt wird und kann auch nur von diesem wieder angefordert werden. Ein Cookie kann von niemand anderem als vom Absender gelesen werden.

Sind Cookies gefährlich?

Cookies sind nicht gefährlich. Sie können keinen ausführbaren Programmcode oder sonstigen gefährlichen Programme enthalten. Cookies können nur wieder gelesen werden und dabei keine anderen Daten von der Festplatte auslesen und ausspionieren. Auch können Cookies nichts auf Ihre Festplatte schreiben außer sich selbst.

Herzlich Willkommen auf der Vergabeplattform vergabe.bayern!

Das Bayerische Staatsministerium für Wohnen, Bau und Verkehr präsentiert hiermit eine innovative Anwendung, die weit über den Bereich der elektronischen Datenverarbeitung hinausreicht.

Vergabeunterlagen und Angebote werden dabei rechtsgültig und vertraulich über das Internet versendet. Bayern bietet eine Vergabelösung, die mit IT-SEC E2 (hoch) zertifiziert ist und regemäßig mit BayernCERT geprüft wird.

Die Vergabeplattform stellt die Kommunikation zwischen staatlichen Vergabestellen und Unternehmen im Rahmen von Vergabeverfahren nach VOB, UVgO und VgV auf eine moderne elektronische Basis.

observed.title: ROLECSP - Registro Oficial de Licitadores y Empresas Clasificadas del Sector Público
observed.head:
Bienvenido
Activar ayuda 




Para poder hacer uso de la firma electrónica en Rolece debe tener instalada la aplicación Autofirma.

 

Puede descargar la aplicación autoFirma en el siguiente enlace.

Bienvenid@ al Registro Oficial de Licitadores y Empresas Clasificadas del Sector Público

 

El Registro Oficial de Licitadores y Empresas Clasificadas del Sector Público se crea en cumplimiento de lo dispuesto en los artículos 301 a 307 de la Ley 30/2007, de 30 de octubre, de Contratos del Sector Público.

 

Los empresarios pueden inscribir en él los datos a los que se refiere el artículo 339 de la Ley 9/2017, de 8 de noviembre, de Contratos del Sector Público, y sus certificados acreditan frente a todos los órganos de contratación del sector público, a tenor de lo en ellos reflejado y salvo prueba en contrario, las condiciones de aptitud del empresario en cuanto a su personalidad y capacidad de obrar, representación, habilitación profesional o empresarial, solvencia económica y financiera, y clasificación, así como la concurrencia o no concurrencia de las prohibiciones de contratar que deban constar en el mismo.

 

El Registro tiene carácter electrónico, y tanto las solicitudes de inscripción como la obtención de certificados se tramitan de modo telemático, acreditándose la identidad del solicitante mediante el uso de un certificado electrónico.

 

Medios de acceso: Es necesario disponer de un certificado electrónico. Existen dos formas de acceder a Rolece con certificado electrónico: puede hacerlo con certificado electrónico a través de Clave o mediante el cliente de Autofirma que requiere tener instalada la aplicación Autofirma. Dispone de más detalle en el documento Certificados Admitidos
 
Se ha desarrollado una nueva herramienta VISOR del Registro Oficial de Licitadores y Empresas que ofrece la facilidad de visualizar de forma amigable en formatos PDF y HTML, los siguientes documentos: Certificado ROLECE y Documento Europeo DEUC en su versión v.1.0.2.
La herramienta VISOR está disponible en la dirección (se abre en nueva ventana):https://visor.registrodelicitadores.gob.es

observed.title: სახელმწიფო შესყიდვების სააგენტო
observed.head:
მოგესალმებით! თქვენ იმყოფებით სახელმწიფო შესყიდვების ერთიან ელექტრონულ სისტემაში, რომელიც წარმოადგენს საქართველოში სახელმწიფო შესყიდვებთან დაკავშირებული საქმიანობის ოფიციალურ პორტალს. იგი უზრუნველყოფს ღია, გამჭვირვალე და კონკურენტუნარიან გარემოს სახელმწიფო შესყიდვების პროცედურებში მონაწილე ნებისმიერი პირისათვის. სახელმწიფო შესყიდვების ერთიანი ელექტრონული სისტემის ფუნქციონირებას უზრუნველყოფს სახელმწიფო შესყიდვების სააგენტო.

სახელმწიფო შესყიდვების ერთიან ელექტრონულ სისტემაში რეგისტრაცია სავალდებულოა მხოლოდ შემსყიდველებისათვის და მიმწოდებლებისთვის

რეგისტრირებული მომხმარებელი  პაროლი   
შესვლა
 

სტუმარი
 
მომხმარებლის რეგისტრაცია
 
შეტყობინება ადმინისტრატორს
 
პაროლის აღდგენა

ქარ
 
Eng
 
Рус

სახელმწიფო შესყიდვების ერთიან ელექტრონული სისტემაში არარეგისტრირებულ არარეზიდენტ პირებს ბაზრის კვლევის ელექტრონულ მოდულში შეთავაზების წარდგენა შეუძლიათ სისტემაში „მიმწოდებლის“ სტატუსით რეგისტრაციის გარეშე, მარტივი რეგისტრაციის გავლით. კერძოდ, ღილაკზე „ბაზრის კვლევაში მონაწილე მომხმარებლის რეგისტრაცია“ დაჭერით, ეკრანზე გამოჩნდება რეგისტრაციისთვის განკუთვნილი სამუშაო ველები.

გთხოვთ, გაითვალისწინოთ, რომ აღნიშნული რეგისტრაციის ფორმა არ არის განკუთვნილი სისტემაში „მიმწოდებლად“ რეგისტრირებული პირებისთვის.

ბაზრის კვლევაში მონაწილე მომხმარებლის რეგისტრაცია
ყურადღება!

ამ გვერდის საშუალებით თქვენ შეგიძლიათ შეხვიდეთ სახელმწიფო შესყიდვების ერთიან ელექტრონულ სისტემაში. სისტემაში დარეგისტრირებული ყველა მომხმარებელი საქართველოს კანონმდებლობის შესაბამისად პასუხს აგებს მის მიერ სისტემაში განხორციელებული ყველა ქმედების იურიდიულ შედეგებზე. სახელმწიფო შესყიდვების სააგენტო პასუხს არ აგებს სახელმწიფო შესყიდვების ელექტრონული სისტემის გამოყენებით გამოწვეულ ნებისმიერი სახის ზიანზე.

სახელმწიფო შესყიდვების ერთიანი ელექტრონული სისტემის მომხმარებლის სახელმძღვანელო

Poštovani korisnici,


ovim putem želimo vas informirati da će, uslijed prestanka mogućnosti provedbe pojedinih funkcionalnosti na „starom“ Elektroničkom oglasniku javne nabave Republike Hrvatske, počevši od 1. siječnja 2026. godine, biti nužno poduzeti određene radnje s vaše strane radi osiguranja neprekinute i pravilne provedbe postupaka javne nabave.


Navedene radnje odnose se na postupke i tehnike javne nabave uređene Zakonom o javnoj nabavi, a osobito na dinamičke sustave nabave, okvirne sporazume, ponovnu provedbu nadmetanja (mini-nadmetanja) te izmjene ugovora, koji će se od navedenog datuma provoditi isključivo putem „novog“ Elektroničkog oglasnika javne nabave RH.




U nastavku donosimo pregled obveza i postupanja koje je potrebno poduzeti.

 

1. Dinamički sustavi nabave

Naručitelji su dužni okončati dinamičke sustave nabave uspostavljene na „starom“ EOJN-u RH.
Ukoliko postoji potreba, naručitelji mogu uspostaviti identične dinamičke sustave nabave na „novom“ EOJN-u RH.

 

2. Okvirni sporazumi i mini-nadmetanja

Evidencija ugovora sklopljenih na temelju okvirnih sporazuma od 1. siječnja 2026. godine objavljivat će se isključivo na „novom“ EOJN-u RH.
Ponovna provedba nadmetanja (mini-nadmetanja) temeljem sklopljenih okvirnih sporazuma, od navedenog datuma, provodit će se isključivo putem „novog“ EOJN-a RH.

 

3. Izmjene ugovora i okvirnih sporazuma

Sve izmjene ugovora o javnoj nabavi i okvirnih sporazuma tijekom njihova trajanja, počevši od 1. siječnja 2026. godine, objavljivat će se isključivo na „novom“ EOJN-u RH.

 

Radi lakšeg snalaženja i pravodobne pripreme, korisnicima je na raspolaganju i „demo“ instanca Elektroničkog oglasnika javne nabave RH
(https://eojn-web-demo.azurewebsites.net), putem koje se mogu upoznati s funkcionalnostima vezanim uz migraciju postupaka.

 




Napominjemo koje će funkcionalnost biti dostupne na „starom“ EOJN-u RH i nakon 1. siječnja 2026. godine

Elektronička žalba

Elektroničke žalbe započete na „starom“ EOJN RH završit će se na „starom“ EOJN RH.
Za postupke mini nadmetanja koji su pokrenuti na starom EOJN RH, elektroničke žalbe provodit će se na „starom“ EOJN RH.
﻿

Vođenje evidencije isplaćenih iznosa po sklopljenim ugovorima o javnoj nabavi, u modulu „Registar ugovora“, sukladno zakonskim obvezama izvještavanja.

מאגרי ספקים

להלן ריכוז מאגרי הספקים (רשימות מציעים) המנוהלים על ידי משרדי הממשלה (קישורים לדפי המאגרים)

מאגרי ספקים בתחומים שונים

משרדי הממשלה מקימים מאגרי ספקים בנושאי התמחות שונים, לפי צרכיהם, במסגרת תהליכי הרכש הממשלתיים. מאגרי הספקים מפורסמים באופן מרוכז בדף זה באתר מינהל הרכש הממשלתי ומכילים מידע נוסף דוגמת נהלי הצטרפות למאגר, תחומי פעילות המאגר, רשימות המציעים ועוד. ניהול מאגרי הספקים של הממשלה נעשה בהתאם לחוק חובת המכרזים, התשנ"ב – 1992 ו-תקנות חובת המכרזים, התשנ"ג – 1993 וכן הוראות התכ"ם הרלוונטיות בנושא זה בפרק 7.7.2 להוראות התכ"ם. ההוראות בנושא זה משקפות את עקרונות הרכש הממשלתי וביניהם שוויון הזדמנויות, מינהל תקין ושקיפות, יעילות ותחרות. בניהול מאגרי הספקים, מבקשים משרדי הממשלה להרחיב את מעגל ספקיהם, תוך שיפור וייעול מערך האספקה והגברת בקרת האיכות וטיב המוצרים והשירותים הנרכשים. פניות בנושא מאגרי הספקים של המשרדים, נא להפנות למשרד, מנהל המאגר. פניות של משרדים בנושא הקמה וניהול מאגרי ספקים, נא לפנות למינהל הרכש הממשלתי באמצעות "צור קשר".

Individual Consultants
All Individual Consultants must:
Be a citizen of an ADB member country*
Be competent and qualified for the work they are recruited to perform
Not be on any ADB sanction or suspension list due to integrity violations or poor performance, or on any recognized terrorism list

*Note: Consultants from non-ADB countries may be engaged only if a project allows it.



Consulting Firms
All Consulting Firms must:
Be legal entities that have the capacity to enter into binding and enforceable contracts with the ADB
Be incorporated or legally established in an ADB member country*
Not be on any ADB sanction or suspension list due to integrity violations or poor performance, or on any recognized terrorism list
Have a bank account for financial transactions
The ADB's requirements on place of incorporation or legal establishment are as follows:
Corporations or companies must be incorporated in an ADB member country*
Partnerships that are not incorporated and have individual members must be duly registered in an ADB member country*
Universities, institutions, public sector organizations and non-governmental organizations (NGOs) that are not legally incorporated must provide details that establish their legal capacity to enter into binding and enforceable contracts with the ADB (e.g. by charter, statute, etc.)

*Note: Consultants from non-ADB countries may be engaged only if a project allows it.



Executing Agencies

Executing Agencies (EAs) are government or non-government agencies that work with ADB to monitor/implement a project or program. The executing agency may also be a "borrower."
To request an EA account for posting recruitment notices, email the following details to your ADB Project Officer, with csrn@adb.org, in copy.

Name and address of the agency
ADB Agency Code (can be obtained from ADB Project Officer/Analyst)
Preferred Username
First and Last Name of the agency representative
Email address of the agency representative

Note: This registration procedure is for EAs only and does not apply to either consulting firms or individual consultants.

Procurement

Under the fiduciary responsibility defined in the Agreement establishing the African Development Bank, the Bank is required to ensure that the proceeds of the projects and programs it finances are used exclusively for the activities for which they were granted.

The Agreement also requires that particular attention be paid to the efficiency of procurement processes for projects financed by the Bank.

This is why the Bank favors the most open competitive procedures possible for the acquisition of goods, works and services.

Procurement procedures must offer equal opportunities to contractors, suppliers, and consultants from the Bank's member countries. The procurement process must also be transparent.

The Bank has drawn up "Rules and Procedures for the Procurement of Goods and Works" and "Rules and Procedures for the Use of Consultants", which govern procurement under Bank-financed projects.

To assist borrowing countries, the Bank has also developed, in collaboration with other multilateral development banks, standard bidding documents to be used for Bank-financed contracts.

AU Procurement

The Procurement function of the AU is undertaken by the Procurement Division within the Directorate of Administration & Human Resources Management (AHRM) of the AUC and the Procurement Units of AU Organs and Institutions. The Procurement Unit of each entity has the responsibility for the coordination of the procurement function in a professional manner by ensuring efficiency, accountability, value for money and transparency in the requisition, recording, accounting for, or any form of management of suppliers.

The Procurement Regulatory Framework for the AU is set out in the Financial Rules and Regulation (FRR) and the Procurement Manual provides the necessary guidelines to ensure all procurement activities are undertaken in compliance with the FRR and other applicable legal instruments and documents.

observed.title: Corporate Procurement Opportunities
observed.head:
BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES
CORPORATE PROCUREMENT OPPORTUNITIES
    

Welcome to the AIIB’s Corporate Procurement website. This website has been designed to provide useful information to interested vendors on the policy, process and opportunities in relation to corporate procurement.

Corporate Procurement Division (CPD) is responsible for procurement of goods, works, consulting services and other services required by the Bank to fulfill its institutional requirements.

The principles governing the Bank’s corporate procurement are based upon the Bank’s core values: Lean, Clean and Green. The objective of the Bank’s corporate procurement is to obtain the appropriate goods, works and services for the stated purpose, at the appropriate time and cost and in a manner that balances the overall institutional requirements for economy, efficiency, value for money, transparency, accountability, environmental and social sustainability.

The Annual Corporate Procurement Report provides summary of CPD’s annual procurement activities.

The updated AIIB Policy on Corporate Procurement was approved by the Board of Directors on May 7, 2020.

The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) is a multilateral development bank whose mission is Financing Infrastructure for Tomorrow in Asia and beyond—infrastructure with sustainability at its core. We began operations in Beijing in 2016 and have since grown to 111 approved members worldwide. We are capitalized at USD100 billion and AAA-rated by the major international credit rating agencies. Collaborating with partners, AIIB meets clients’ needs by unlocking new capital and investing in infrastructure that is green, technology-enabled and promotes regional connectivity.

observed.head:
BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES
PROJECT PROCUREMENT OPPORTUNITIES
    
VIEW ALL OPPORTUNITIES  SUBSCRIBE TO RSS FEED





AIIB’s Procurement Policy affirms the Bank’s commitment to supporting the successful implementation of Bank-financed projects through efficient, fair, ethical, and transparent procurement processes, delivering the best value for money, providing tailored solutions, and promoting social and environmental sustainability.

Procurement Policy (June 26, 2024)
Directive on Procurement Instructions for Recipients (July 26, 2024)

AIIB-financed projects offer a broad range of business opportunities for goods, works, nonconsulting services, and consulting services. The procurement process is open, fair, and nondiscriminatory and provides equitable opportunity and treatment for tenderers and consultants. Eligible firms and individuals worldwide are encouraged to participate in these opportunities. Upcoming business opportunities for goods, infrastructure construction works, and services can be found here.

The Bank’s business outreach activities aim to promote business opportunities and strengthen private-sector participation in AIIB-financed projects. Details about the events and presentation materials can be found here.

Procurement-related Complaints:

The administration of procurement-related complaints are detailed in the Bank’s Directive on Procurement Instructions for Recipients (July 26, 2024), Annex III, Administration of Procurement Related Complaints.

If a tenderer/consultant wishes to make a procurement-related complaint, the tenderer/consultant shall submit their complaint following the instructions specified in the procurement documents.

Standard Procurement Documents

AIIB has prepared Standard Procurement Documents (SPDs) for use by the Bank’s public-sector clients for the procurement of goods, works, nonconsulting services, and consulting services that are subject to international open competitive tendering or selection. The Bank is not party to the contract and does not accept legal responsibility for the adequacy of the contract forms contained in these SPDs. Bank clients are therefore advised to ensure that the contract conditions are suitable and complete in respect of any particular contract. When drafting specific documents, clients are encouraged to seek legal and/or professional advice, as deemed appropriate.

AIIB has published the Operational Procurement Report annually since 2022. The report presents statistics and analysis of signed procurement contracts under the Bank’s sovereign-backed financings and Project Preparation Special Fund grants.

La Entidad Binacional Yacyretá avanzó con una nueva etapa del Plan de Renovación de Activos de Generación mediante el retiro del rotor de la Unidad Generadora N.º 10 (UG10), una de las maniobras de mayor complejidad técnica previstas dentro del proceso de rehabilitación de los generadores de la Central Hidroeléctrica Yacyretá. La intervención forma parte del programa de rehabilitación que la Entidad viene ejecutando conforme a un cronograma técnico previamente establecido, mediante el cual se realizan intervenciones programadas sobre los principales componentes de las unidades generadoras con el objetivo de extender su vida útil, mantener su confiabilidad, disponibilidad y eficiencia operativa.

Connection

Innovation

Neo is an Oracle-based system designed to make doing business with NCIA simpler for industry. NCIA launched Neo in 2022 as part of a wider effort to boost collaboration with the private sector by simplifying competition cycles and providing enhanced account management.

Registration

From January 2024 all business with NCIA is performed through Neo eProcurement. Register now to ensure you can be competition-ready and to have access to the platform.

Fill in and sign the Supplier Registration Form and send it to neo.registration@ncia.nato.int. In the form, Suppliers are asked to identify the main Neo Account Manager and Financial contact, as well as agree to the attached Neo Terms of Use.
NCIA will send you an acknowledgement email.
REGISTRATION FORM
Once your records have been verified by NCIA, your Neo account will be created. There are two security layers to allow access to Neo:
The first set of credentials to access Neo Gateway.
The second set of credentials to access Neo Login.
2. Neo Credentials

Part 1

Neo Gateway

You will receive an SMS with your username and a temporary password. (The temporary password expires after 30 days. Make sure to activate your account within that timeframe, otherwise request a new gateway access through the Neo Service Desk).
Go to Neo Gateway Login and enter your gateway credentials.
NEO GATEWAY LOGIN
Follow screen instructions to change your password at first login.
For all future gateway logins, you will also need a one-time confirmation code sent via SMS.

Neo Landing Page

After the Gateway, you are redirected to the Neo Landing Page.
This is your guidance hub with all information about how to navigate through the system.
Click on Neo Login in the top right corner of the Neo Landing Page.


Part 2

Neo Login

For the Neo Login, you should have received two separate emails:
Email containing your username
Email with your temporary password
Enter your credentials and follow the instructions on the screen to set your personal password.
You now have access to Neo dashboard. For more details on navigating the system according to your assigned role, please refer to the guidance available on the Neo Landing Page.


Part 3

Neo Service Desk Account

All registered Suppliers will receive an invitation to self-register to the Neo Service Desk.
Neo Service Desk is accessible through both Neo Landing Page, as well as directly through the URL from the email
In case there is a need for Neo Service Desk password reset for any of the supplier accounts in Neo, Account Managers must raise a ticket in Neo Service Desk.

Supplier Instructions:

Thank you for your interest in registering in EPS and becoming a registered supplier for New Development Bank. It is important that you read the Supplier Instructions. Before registration, we also recommend you review General Terms and Conditions, Supplier Guide, and Corporate Procurement Plan.

1.General registration process

In order to be a registered supplier, the applicant need to complete the following process:

a. Create system username and complete an account registration process with basic information.

b. Login to the e-procurement system, complete the online registration information and upload the required documents.

c. NDB evaluates suppliers’ registration information and qualifications, and decides either approve or reject the application.

d. The applicant is informed of the “successful” or “returned” status after the registration through the EPS system and email.

2. After registration

After the registration is approved by NDB, the registered supplier would be allowed to participate the procurement and do the following in EPS:

a. Update registration information.

b. Receive procurement notice of open competitive bidding in excess of $100,000 USD. (procurement notice are also announced to the public on the portal website)。

c. Receive procurement invitations made by NDB.

d. Receive award of notification if the supplier is awarded a contract.

e. Download RFP/FRQ and upload proposal for the procurement project. All documents in EPS are encrypted in a secure environment.

f. Check procurement progress.

g. Review contract information and payment status.

3. Use of the system

a. All information provided by the applicant requires true, accurate, verified and current information and documentation. Completion of a supplier registration, however, does not guarantee that a supplier will be approved.

b. Successful registration indicates that the supplier is eligible to participate in NDB procurement project. It does not guarantee that the supplier will be selected to participate in limited procurement project or be awarded any contract.

c. NDB’sgeneral terms and conditions are posted on the EPS portal website. It is the supplier’s responsibility to review the terms and conditions prior to bidding

d. observed.title: OPEC Fund Procurement - OPEC Fund for International Development
h1: Subscribe to the OPEC Fund Newsletters
observed.head:
The OPEC Fund for
International Development
Overview

The OPEC Fund Corporate Procurement principles are a set of ethical standards, to which the institution and its suppliers are bound during the bidding process and throughout the execution of a contract. The main principles are:

Best value for money
Fairness, integrity and transparency
Effective competition
Efficiency and economy
Best value for money

This is the trade-off between price and performance that provides the greatest overall benefit under the specified evaluation criteria. The OPEC Fund’s Corporate Procurement procedures aim to ensure the best value for money, by reference to the optimum combination of life cycle costing of a purchase (i.e. maintenance, running and disposal costs) and its fitness for purpose (i.e. quality and ability to meet the OPEC Fund’s requirements). This definition includes economic and environmental objectives within the procurement process.

Fairness, integrity and transparency

The OPEC Fund ensures fairness by offering equal access to the same opportunity. A fair process is free from nepotism, favoritism, self-interest or preference in judgement. Professional integrity and transparency are also key fundamentals of the OPEC Fund’s Corporate Procurement Policy. Integrity is ensured by strong moral principles, including honesty and decency. All aspects of a procurement process are visible and evident to all stakeholders. Information on procurement, procedures, opportunities and processes is clearly, concurrently and publicly defined to all interested parties.

Effective competition

By fostering effective competition among suppliers, the OPEC Fund applies the principles of fairness, integrity and transparency to achieve best value for money. The OPEC Fund aims to achieve effective competition under the following conditions:

There are a sufficient number of prospective suppliers
Prospective suppliers are independent of each other
Competition for the same business opportunity is under the same conditions
There is a sufficient number of offers responding to the procurement opportunity
Efficiency and economy

Procurement processes are well organized, and carried out with regard to quantity, quality, price, timelines and within the approved budget in line with the OPEC Fund Financial Regulations. The processes applied are proportionate to the value and complexity of the requirement, to ensure that associated costs are minimized and in line with the activity budget.

Solicitation documents for competitive bidding i.e. Requests for Proposals (RFP), Requests for Quotations (RFQ), Invitation to Bid (ITB), Request for Information (RFI) or Expression of Interests (EoI), including deadlines and detailed instructions for submitting bids, will be posted on this website as they arise.

observed.head:
Choose language

About SEPA – General History


The Procurement Plan Execution System [Sistema de Ejecución de Planes de Adquisiciones SEPA] is an innovative Internet platform developed in 2006 by the World Bank to provide public access to contracts executed in the framework of its investment portfolio in the region. Thanks to its soundness, reliability, and security, its use has spread rapidly throughout Latin America and the Caribbean. In July 2008, the World Bank (IBRD) and the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) signed a memorandum of understanding to share use of this tool and thus improve governance of projects and contribute to the development goals of the Millennium Development Goals

SEPA provides public access to basic information on all contracts executed in the framework of projects financed by the World Bank (IBRD) and the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) in the countries of the region, as well as the procurement and contracting processes planned and their status.

This information is presented in the format of Procurement Plans1 in which the Executing Units of the projects – at their various levels – plan the procurement/activities that will be done during a period of 12 to 18 months. This data makes it possible to know (i) the plans for each project, (ii) the status of execution of the plan, and (iii) specific details for each contract financed under the project.

The purpose of this tool is to promote transparency, strengthen accountability, and give the governments and executing units for projects with external funding an instrument for management of procurement in all projects funded by the IBRD and the IDB.

SEPA evolved as it expanded in the region, offering access to all users in various languages, changing from a single-institutional system to a multi-institutional one.

SEPA is an extremely useful tool for the following stakeholders:


Executing Units: it facilitates project management for the members of the executing team, because it makes it possible to plan the activities and monitor execution of the project’s total budget. It also generates relevant information on the efficiency of the procurement and contract management processes.
Government: it is valuable for monitoring investment and public expenditure, which can be analyzed in its various facets with management reports on the entire portfolio of projects financed by the IBRD and IDB.
IBRD and IDB: it permits the review, approval, and follow-up of project procurement plans, and monitoring of their implementation.
Citizens: it affords access to detailed information on the contracts of projects financed by the institutions.
Private sector: it furnishes access to 100 percent of all contracting planned for the projects.


Furthermore, SEPA:

Provides high capacity advanced search in the universe of contracts financed by the IBRD and IDB,
Offers an innovative and interactive graphic tool and indicators that facilitate performance analysis of the portfolio by country and by region
Permits processing of available information in the system by exporting it to a spreadsheet,
Generates management reports for follow-up and monitoring.


In this way, the information that SEPA provides to all users introduces a large measure of transparency to the management of projects financed by institutions in the region.

NJSSが選ばれる6つの理由
01豊富な入札情報件数

全国9,000 件を超える発注機関の中から情報を収集しており、年間290万件以上の案件を収集しております。
豊富な情報量で、お客様に合った案件や意外な案件などを見つけ出すことが可能です。

02精度の高い情報

入札案件については、PDF形式、テキスト形式など様々なフォーマットで掲載され、WEBサイト上の掲載場所も機関によって異なるため、クローラーによる自動取得のみでは漏れが発生する可能性があります。
そこで、NJSSではクローラーによる自動取得と合わせて人が目視で各機関の入札案件を確認して掲載しております。

03万全なフォロー体制

お客様が1件でも多く案件を落札できるように、弊社サポートスタッフが全力でサポートいたします。
NJSSの操作方法はもちろん、入札でお悩み事があれば、ご相談ください。

※
一部有料のサポートを含みます。

04落札情報も掲載

NJSSでは入札情報に限らず、入札結果（落札情報）も収集しております。
過去の落札会社と金額を確認することが出来るため、定期的に公示される案件の入札金額がある程度算出でき、落札の可能性も上げることが可能です。

05競合企業の動向調査

過去の落札実績から、落札会社の調査も可能です。
落札の傾向やどの案件を落札しているか、またどの機関の案件を落札しているかなど、同業他社の入札動向を探り、戦略的に入札を行うことが可能です。

06業務の効率化が図れる

NJSSの案件情報は毎月数万件追加される為、自社での収集では集めることが難しい件数となります。
もし自社で毎月数万件を集める場合は、膨大な人件費がかかります。業務の効率化の面からも、NJSSはご活用いただけます。

全省庁統一資格について
全省庁統一資格とは

統一基準で審査した各省庁が定める物品の製造・販売等に係る一般競争（指名競争）参加者の資格です。
各省庁が掲げる申請場所のいずれか1か所に申請し、資格を付与された場合において、その資格は該当する競争参加地域のうち、希望する地域ごとに所在する各省庁の全調達機関において有効な統一資格となるものです。

1 本資格が有効となる各省各庁

衆議院、参議院、国立国会図書館、最高裁判所、会計検査院、内閣官房、内閣法制局、人事院、内閣府本府、宮内庁、公正取引委員会、警察庁、個人情報保護委員会、カジノ管理委員会、サイバー通信情報監理委員会、金融庁、消費者庁、こども家庭庁、デジタル庁、復興庁、総務省、法務省、外務省、財務省、文部科学省、厚生労働省、農林水産省、経済産業省、国土交通省、環境省及び防衛省で外局及び附属機関その他の機関並びに地方支分部局を含む。

2 競争参加地域及び都道府県名
（1）北海道：北海道
（2）東北：青森県、岩手県、宮城県、秋田県、山形県、福島県
（3）関東・甲信越：茨城県、栃木県、群馬県、埼玉県、千葉県、東京都、神奈川県、新潟県、山梨県、長野県
（4）東海・北陸：富山県、石川県、福井県、岐阜県、静岡県、愛知県、三重県
（5）近畿：滋賀県、京都府、大阪府、兵庫県、奈良県、和歌山県
（6）中国：鳥取県、島根県、岡山県、広島県、山口県
（7）四国：徳島県、香川県、愛媛県、高知県
（8）九州・沖縄：福岡県、佐賀県、長崎県、熊本県、大分県、宮崎県、鹿児島県、沖縄県

개인정보 재동의

한국수출입은행은 개도국에서 발주되는 개발차관 프로젝트의 타당성 검토, 설계, 감리 등 컨설팅 업무 수행에 적합한 인력과 경험을 보유하고도 해외사업 수주에 어려움을 겪고 있는 국내 기업 및 개인을 지원하기 위해 [컨설턴트 Pool]을 구성하여 운영하고 있습니다.

등록회원에 대해서는 한국수출입은행이 컨설턴트를 고용하거나 국제개발금융기관 등에 추천 시 등록정보를 우선 활용하고 개발차관 프로젝트 입찰정보 제공 및 해외진출 관련 세미나의 초대 등 다양한 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.

교통, 정보통신(ICT), 에너지, 환경, 보건, 교육, 상하수도, 농수산, 도시계획, 산업분석, 금융 등 국제개발 프로젝트 관련분야

한국국제협력단에서 알려드립니다.

최근 업체로 유선 및 개인휴대전화를 활용하여 한국국제협력단 직원임을 사칭하는 전화 또는 문자메시지 사기 피싱 범죄로 의심되는 사례가 접수되고 있어 안내드립니다.

우리 기관은 긴급하게 전화 등을 이용하여 물품 납품을 요청하지 않으며, 계약과 상관없는 일체의 행위를 진행하지 않습니다. 피해가 발생하지 않도록 각별한 주의를 당부드립니다.

이와 유사하거나 의심스러운 연락을 받은 경우에는 한국국제협력단 조달계약2팀으로 연락하여 담당직원 연결 후 사실 관계 확인을 부탁드립니다.

The need for registration for contracting authority
to purchase goods and services in the e-ordering subsystem;

to participate in the procurement procedures in order to supply goods/ services in the e-orders subsystem;
to participate in the procurement procedures announced in the e-tenders subsystem;
to check the reasons for exclusion for themselves in the e-certificates subsytem
	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	
 
Registration documents to be submitted to the State Digital Development Agency
filled in registration blank of the participant;
filled in participant's administrator's authorization blank.
	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	
 
Registration blanks
 
Blanks in accordance with the Regulations No. 816 of the Cabinet of Ministers of 20.12.2022 "Public electronic procurement regulations" (annex 2 and 3)
 
Filled in blanks can be submitted either in:
Paper form (by mailing to Alberta iela 10, Riga, LATVIA, LV-1010),
Electronic form with a secure electronic signature* (by sending an electronic signed document to e-mail: pasts@vdaa.gov.lv) .

*The site to verify the electronic signature must be specified if the files are signed with non-Latvian e-signature.

For information on filling in the registration blanks, please consult Zigurds Drafens - zigurds.drafens@vdaa.gov.lv, tel. +371-67509520.

	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	
 Caution!
If the registration blanks are filled in without errors, the participant is registered within three working days.

Ce este MTender
Ministerul Finanțelor al Republicii Moldova conduce o tranziție la achizițiile publice electronice pentru a asigura o utilizare mai transparentă și mai eficientă a bugetului de stat al Republicii Moldova. Noul serviciu guvernamental digital - MTender - va sprijini achizițiile publice de la planificarea achiziției până la plata pentru contractele de achiziții publice. Acesta va scurta timpul pentru licitații pentru instituțiile publice și timpul de așteptare pentru plăți pentru furnizori și contractori.
Cu serviciul digital MTender, toate licitațiile publice sunt accesibile online și fiecare decizie de achiziție publică este publicată în mod transparent online în timp real. Cetățenii pot urmări deciziile privind achizițiile publice și modul în care sunt cheltuiți banii plătitorilor de impozite.
Noul serviciu de achiziții publice complet electronic va oferi un acces mai bun la oportunitățile pentru comunitatea de afaceri, în special întreprinderile mici și mijlocii locale.
Pentru instituțiile publice, noul serviciu digital va aduce, de asemenea, o planificare îmbunătățită a cheltuielilor, achiziții mai rapide și mai calitative, ca urmare a procedurilor electronice de licitare care implică ”zero hârtie”.
Sistemul informaţional automatizat “Registrul de stat al achiziţiilor publice” MTender este un sistem de achiziții electronice, alcătuit dintr-un portal web și o Unitate Centrală de Date de date de tip deschis (Open Data) și platformele acreditate din sectorul privat pentru a sprijini licitațiile desfășurate electronic pentru utilizatori și din sectorul public și din sectorul privat.
Platforma electronica de achiziții este o platformă comercială electronică de achiziții publice, acreditată pentru conectarea cu MTender și oferă servicii de licitație electronică digitală atât clienților din sectorul public, cât și cumpărătorilor din sectorul privat. Fiecare platformă de achiziții MTender oferă un serviciu de asistență (Help Desk) pentru autorități contractante și operatori economici înregistrați pe această platformă pentru a accesa serviciile electronice ale MTender.

observed.head:
CRNOGORSKE
ELEKTRONSKE
JAVNE NABAVKE

Politika javnih nabavki u Crnoj Gori uređena je Zakonom o javnim nabavkama ("Službeni list Crne Gore", br. 074/19), koji sa setom podzakonske regulative kreira okvir pravnog djelovanja u sistemu javnih nabavki.

Uspješnom realizacijom projekta “Implementacija elektronskog sistema javnih nabavki” koji se sprovodi od 2018. god. uz podršku Evropske komisije, a finansira iz IPA sredstva, stvorio se preduslov za uvođenje elektronskog sistema javnih nabavki u Crnoj Gori.

Ovaj procedularni korak ima za cilj promjenu koncepta javnih nabavki, uz pojednostavljenje postupka nabavke, kao i za povećanje transparentnosti cjelokupnog sistema.

Kako javna nabavka predstavlja strateški instrument u paketu mjera ekonomske politike svake države cilj uvođenje elektronskog sisitema javnih nabavki je dobiti što veću vrijednost za novac, kao i postići bolje rezultate u pogledu društvenih i drugih ciljeva javnih politika povećavajući pritom efikasnost javne potrošnje.

Crnogorske elektronske javne nabavke predstavljaju alat za unapređenje efikasnosti procesa javne nabavke roba, usluga i radova a koji će voditi ostvarivanju ušteda u javnom sektoru.

Vlada Crne Gore izražava zahvalnost Evropskoj komisiji za podršku našim reformama u dijelu sistema javnih nabavki.

GET STARTED

RECOMMENDED
SAP Ariba Vendor Registration

Register directly on the SAP Ariba Sourcing platform. This is the primary registration portal for new vendors seeking to participate in upstream oil and gas procurement.

Complete online registration form
Submit required documentation
Access bid and sourcing opportunities
Manage your vendor profile
Register on SAP Ariba
NipeX VMS (NJQS Portal)

Access the Nigerian Joint Qualification System (NJQS) portal for vendor categorization, prequalification, and product/service code management.

Categorize your products and services
Complete prequalification assessments
Maintain compliance status
Access NJQS Portal
Important Notice: Vendor Categorization

All suppliers are required to categorize their product and/or service codes under the approved NipeX rankings (Category A - D) on the NJQS platform. Non-compliance may result in exclusion from bid opportunities.

For assistance with the registration process, contact the NipeX Service Desk at info@nipex.com.ng or call +234 (0) 1 461 0100.

HOW IT WORKS
Registration Process

Follow these steps to complete your vendor registration on the NipeX platform

1
Create Account

Register on the SAP Ariba platform with your company details and contact information.

2
Submit Documents

Upload required documents including CAC certificate, tax clearance, and company profile.

3
NJQS Categorization

Categorize your products and services under the approved NipeX ranking system (A-D).

4
Prequalification

Complete the prequalification assessment to become eligible for bid opportunities.

5
Start Bidding

Access tender opportunities and submit competitive bids through the NipeX platform.

HELP
Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about the NipeX vendor registration process

Who can register as a vendor on NipeX?

Any company or business entity that provides goods or services to the upstream oil and gas industry in Nigeria can register as a vendor on the NipeX platform. This includes Nigerian and international companies with valid business registrations.

What documents are required for registration?

Required documents typically include: Certificate of Incorporation (CAC), Tax Clearance Certificate, Company Profile, Evidence of Financial Capability, HSE Policy, and relevant industry certifications. Specific requirements may vary by vendor category.

How long does the registration process take?

The initial registration can be completed online within a few hours. However, the full prequalification process, including document verification and assessment, may take 2-4 weeks depending on the completeness of submitted documentation.

Is there a registration fee?

Please contact the NipeX Service Desk for current information on registration fees and payment procedures. Fees may vary based on vendor category and services required.

What are the vendor categories (A-D)?

NipeX categorizes vendors from A to D based on their capabilities, capacity, and track record. Category A represents the highest level of capability, while Category D is the entry level. Vendors can upgrade their category as they build their capacity and track record.

Need Help with Registration?

Our Service Desk team is available to assist you through the registration process.

Contact Service Desk

TenderNed is hét online marktplein voor aanbestedingen van de Nederlandse overheid

Nederland koopt jaarlijks voor ongeveer €116 miljard in. Via overheidsopdrachten, maar ook met opdrachten van speciale sectorbedrijven. Veel van deze opdrachten leveren resultaten op die voor ons allemaal belangrijk zijn, zoals wegen, openbaar vervoer en gezondheidszorg. Een overzicht van de opdrachten vindt u op TenderNed. Heeft een aanbestedende dienst een nieuwe opdracht, dan wordt deze hier aangekondigd. Geïnteresseerde bedrijven dienen een voorstel in en de partij met het beste voorstel mag de opdracht uitvoeren.

Register as a Supplier

Anyone can register to create a GETS account, allowing you to receive notices, subscribe, and respond to opportunities published on GETS. If you already have a RealMe log in you can register now or visit www.realme.govt.nz to create one.

Registration information

Registration only takes a minute with your RealMe log in details. We will request the following additional information from you:

Registered business or trading name.
Address details, country, and time zone.
Personal details including first/last name, email, and telephone number.

Once completed, we will send you an email to confirm your account activation. Please follow the link in the email to activate your account.

If you are new to GETS, we encourage you to read the FAQ and guidance in the supplier user help section of GETS.

RealMe®

RealMe is a service managed by the Department of Internal Affairs. RealMe is designed to make it easier for people to access and use online services that adheres to New Zealand Government security, identity, and privacy legislation.

You do require a RealMe log in to create an account and subscribe to opportunities on GETS.
You do not require a verified RealMe identity when creating an account or subscribing to opportunities on GETS.
Please visit realme.govt.nz to learn more, or access support for your RealMe log in.
	
	
Register as a Purchaser

New organisations

If you are a new organisation or entity (an agency) wanting to post tenders on GETS you need to complete an eligibility assessment. Please complete an application on the New Zealand Government Procurement website. The information provided will assist MBIE to assess the agency's eligibility.

Existing organisations

Please contact your GETS Administrator (ETCO) or purchasing manager who will be able to create a purchaser account (PO) for you.

observed.head:
Catálogos Electrónicos - Aviso
La Central de Compras Públicas (PERÚ COMPRAS) informa a los representantes de marca acreditados y proveedores adjudicatarios que, en el marco del artículo 15° del Reglamento de la Ley de Gobierno Digital aprobado por Decreto Supremo N.º 029-2021-PCM, a partir del 14 de agosto de 2024 se implementará un segundo factor de autenticación para acceder a la plataforma de los Catálogos Electrónicos cuando inicie sesión desde un navegador por primera vez. En ese sentido, a fin de garantizar un acceso seguro y en caso no tenga actualizado el correo electrónico registrado en la plataforma, deberá realizar la actualización correspondiente antes de dicha fecha. Para ello, deberás seguir los siguientes pasos:


1. Ingrese al aplicativo y seleccione la opción "Perfil de usuario" .
2. Actualice su correó electrónico en el campo de Correo electrónico.
3. Dar clic en el botón "Validar Correo" e ingresar su contraseña actual para que el aplicativo notifique el código de validación al correo electrónico consignado en la plataforma, por su representada.
4. Al ingresar a su correo electrónico, deberá ubicar el correo remitido por Perú Compras el cual contiene el mensaje con el código de validación; el mismo que deberá registrarlo en el aplicativo.

Finalmente, a fin de absolver sus consultas sobre el presente procedimiento, se pone a su disposición los siguientes canales de atención: el correo electrónico informes@perucompras.gob.pe, WhatsApp: 942 736 152 y la Central Telefónica (+511) 643-0000 Anexo 8000.

ADVISORIES

REACTIVATION OF PHILGEPS LANDLINE NUMBER

The landline number of the PhilGEPS Customer Service (CS) has been reactivated. In addition to this, the mobile numbers will continue to be utilized strictly for incoming calls. PhilGEPS-CS may also be reached via email. Read more.




CALL FOR MERCHANTS TO JOIN PROCUREMENT ACTIVITIES IN MPHILGEPS DURING THE PIONEER IMPLEMENTATION OF E-BIDDING FACILITY FOR FISCAL YEAR 2023

PS-DBM is offering a FREE training for Merchants on the use, features, and functionalities of the e-Bidding Facility. Read more.




ADVISORY: DOCUMENTARY STAMP TAX (DST) PAYMENT FOR PHILGEPS PLATINUM REGISTRATION

Pursuant to Section 188 of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC), as amended by the Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion (TRAIN) Act, a Thirty Pesos (PhP 30.00) payment, representing Documentary Stamp Tax (DST), shall be collected from merchants for every issued PhilGEPS Certificate of Platinum Registration, effective 2 October 2023. Read more.




AUTOMATIC SUSPENSION OF PLATINUM MEMBERSHIP

Beginning December 10, 2022, PhilGEPS will suspend the Platinum Membership of suppliers with expired "Class A" eligibility documents. The PS-PhilGEPS calls on suppliers to ensure that the uploaded documents on the system are updated. In case of suspension, reactivation can be done through the same platform. Read more.




ISSUANCE OF GPPB RESOLUTION 15-2021 CONCERNING PLATINUM MEMBER MERCHANTS AND PROCURING ENTITIES

In relation to the issuance of the GPPB Resolution 15-2021 dated 14 October 2021, this is to inform the concerned Platinum Member merchants and procuring entities of the new Platinum certificate requirements and to advise the same to apply concomitant amendments in accordance to the said resolution. Read more.




PS-DBM WARNS THE PUBLIC OF ILLEGAL SOLICITATION OF MONEY AND GIFTS

The Procurement Service of the Department of Budget and Management (PS-DBM) has received reports that there are individuals and entities who disguise themselves as representatives of PS-DBM to illegally solicit money from bidders. Read more.

Стари Портал јавних набавки

Добродошли на Портал јавних набавки

Портал јавних набавки је развијен за потребе примене новог Закона о јавним набавкама.

За почетак примене новог Закона коришћењем Портала, предлажемо да прочитате:

Упутства за кориснике новог Портала јавних набавки
Често постављана питања
Обавештење о недоступности Портала јавних набавки

Обавештавамо вас да су због недоступности Портала јавних набавки услед проблема на мрежној инфраструктури, сва отварања понуда код којих је рок за подношење понуда био између 9:10 и 11:59 часова 17. августа 2026. године, блокирана.

С тим у вези, наручиоци су дужни да у овим поступцима јавних набавки поступе у складу са одредбама члана 87. Закона о јавним набавкама („Службени гласник РС“, број 91/19, 92/23).

Обавеза објављивања обавештења о додели уговора, односно обустави поступка

Подсећамо да је чланом 109. став 1. Закона о јавним набавкама („Службени гласник РС“, бр. 91/19 и 92/23, у даљем тексту: Закон) прописано да је наручилац дужан да обавештење о додели уговора пошаље на објављивање у року од 30 дана од дана закључења уговора о јавној набавци или оквирног споразума.

Ставом 2. истог члана је прописано да је наручилац дужан да тромесечно објављује збирно обавештење о додели уговора који су закључени на основу оквирног споразума и на основу система динамичне набавке, у року од 30 дана од дана истека тромесечја у коме су уговори закључени, док је ставом 4. прописано да је у случају обуставе или поништења поступка јавне набавке, наручилац дужан да податке о томе објави у обрасцу обавештења о додели уговора у року од 30 дана од дана коначности одлуке о обустави или поништењу поступка јавне набавке.

Против наручилаца који не поступају на наведени начин, Канцеларија за јавне набавке ће, сходно својим законским овлашћењима, поднети захтев за покретање прекршајног поступка за прекршај прописан чланом 236. став 1. тачка 8 ) Закона.

Верзија 1.21

Обавештавамо вас да је од 31.12.2025. актуелна нова верзија Портала 1.21.

Више информација о новој верзији можете видети овде

Народна банка Србије 1. децембра 2025. године уводи електронске менице

Обавештавамо све учеснике у поступцима јавних набавки да 1. децембра 2025. године почиње с радом Централни регистар електронских меница (ЦРеМ), чиме ће бити омогућено издавање и коришћење меница у електронском облику, које су се до сада користиле искључиво у папирној форми, на меничном бланкету.

Више информација можете добити путем следећег линка:
НБС | Приказ вести

Обавеза објављивања података о набавкама на које се Закон о јавним набавкама не примењује

Сходно члану 181. Закона о јавним набавкама („Службени гласник РС“, бр. 91/19 и 92/23, у даљем тексту: Закон), наручиоци су у обавези да евидентирају податке о вредности и врсти јавних набавки из чл. 11. – 21. Закона и то по сваком основу за изузеће посебно, као и јавне набавке из члана 27. став 1. овог Закона. С тим у вези, подсећамо да су наручиоци дужни да наведене податке за 2025. годину збирно објаве на Порталу јавних набавки најкасније до 31. јануара 2026. године. Упутство о начину евидентирања и објављивања података објављено је на Порталу јавних набавки (линк за приступ наведеном упутству). Када је реч о набавкама које су изузете од примене Закона по основу члана 27. став 1. Закона, наручиоци поред обавезе из члана 181. Закона имају обавезу да на Порталу јавних

observed.title: Elektronická platforma – Informačný systém verejnej správy
h1: Cookies na stránkach Elektronická platforma verejného obstarávania
observed.head:
Preskočiť na hlavný obsah
Cookies na stránkach Elektronická platforma verejného obstarávania

Používame nevyhnutné cookies súbory, ktoré slúžia pre správne fungovanie webových stránok.

Rozumiem
Menu
Vitajte na Elektronickej Platforme

Funkcionality elektronickej platformy sú v súčasnosti zabezpečené s využitím elektronického trhoviska (ET) a informačného systému Elektronického verejného obstarávania (IS EVO).

IS EVO
Časť IS EVO podporuje zadávanie:

– nadlimitných zákaziek (verejná súťaž, užšia súťaž, RKsZ, súťažný dialóg, inovatívne partnerstvo, PRK)
– podlimitných zákaziek (§ 108, 110 až 113)
– zákaziek malého rozsahu (§ 1 ods. 14)


V danom systéme je možné ďalej uskutočniť prípravné trhové konzultácie (PTK), prieskum trhu, dynamický nákupný systém (DNS) a elektronickú aukciu.

ELEKTRONICKÉ TRHOVISKO
Časť Elektronické trhovisko podporuje zadávanie:

– podlimitných zákaziek – Zjednodušený postup pre zákazky na bežne dostupné tovary a služby (§ 109)
– zákaziek malého rozsahu na bežne dostupné tovary a služby


V danom systéme je možné uzavrieť rámcové dohody bez ohľadu na hodnotu zákazky a uskutočniť elektronickú aukciu.

ปตท. ใช้คุกกี้ที่มีความจำเป็นอย่างยิ่งต่อการทำงานของเว็บไซต์ของ ปตท. และประสงค์จะใช้คุกกี้ทางเลือกเพื่อช่วยให้สามารถปรับปรุงเว็บไซต์ของ ปตท. ทั้งนี้ ปตท.จะไม่ใช้คุกกี้ทางเลือกจนกว่าท่านจะอนุญาตให้ ปตท. เปิดใช้งานคุกกี้ดังกล่าว ท่านสามารถศึกษารายละเอียดของการใช้คุกกี้ได้จากนโยบายการใช้คุกกี้ ของ ปตท. ทั้งนี้ หากท่านกดยอมรับคุกกี้ทั้งหมดจะหมายความว่าท่านยินยอมให้ ปตท. บันทึกและใช้คุกกี้ทั้งหมดจากอุปกรณ์ที่ท่านใช้ในการเข้าเว็บไซต์ของ ปตท. เพื่อทำให้การเลื่อนสำรวจหน้าเว็บ และการวิเคราะห์การใช้เว็บไซต์มีประสิทธิภาพยิ่งขึ้น รวมถึงเพื่อสนับสนุนการทำกิจกรรมทางการตลาดของ ปตท.

Тимчасові зміни у реєстрації локалізованих товарів та виробників з 24 серпня 2026 року

В системі Prozorro з 24 серпня вводяться технічні обмеження щодо подачі нових заявок на локалізацію. Пояснюємо нормативне підґрунтя, причини заморозки функціонала та що буде з уже доданими товарами. З 24 серпня 2026 року набувають чинності окремі положення Закону України від 27.05.2026 № 4888-IX «Про публічні закупівлі», що регулюють закупівлю товарів із вимогами щодо локалізації виробництва. Чому виникла технічна пауза? Закон № 4888-IX змінює вимоги до підтвердження локалізації (зокрема розширює номенклатуру товарів, встановлює нові правила розрахунку). Зазначені зміни потребують здійснення заходів з розроблення підзаконних нормативно-правових актів, а також технічної реалізації функціоналу в електронній системі закупівель. Enterprise services, capabilities, and systems supporting the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business process

About PIEE.

The Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) is the primary enterprise procure-to-pay (P2P) application for the Department of Defense and its supporting agencies and is trusted by companies reporting over $7.1 billion in spending.

Increase productivity

PIEE enables automation through every phase of the procurement process reducing manual data entry and administrative tasks from pre-award through contract close.

Reduce risk

With built-in checks, controlled access, workflows, data pre-population and error tracking, PIEE helps ensure contracts, invoices and payment disbursements are as accurate as possible.


 

 

Promote collaboration

PIEE’s Integrated document management and messaging capabilities provide a centralized way to securely communicate and share important information across organizations and roles.

Enhance visibility

Global access to information such as reports, documents, and workflow statuses allow all users to have greater visibility into the procurement process at any time.

PIEE Features.
Award

Along with a contract writing system, PIEE offers access to many tools to assist with the award process including Solicitation Portal, Clause Logic Service (CLS), and the Supplier Performance Risk System.

SOLICITATION SEARCH

LEARN ABOUT CLS

Operations Support

PIEE's Operations Support layer offers tools to Department of Defense and Service leads who help oversee the P2P process such as a process model library and DoDAAC Purpose Code Management.

LEARN ABOUT PIEE

Payment

Supporting the receipt, acceptance, and payment process has been one of PIEE's longest missions. Wide Area Workflow (WAWF) is the backbone of the payment capabilities set with other modules providing additional visibility into this business process.

LEARN ABOUT PIEE

Post Award Administration

With functionality to support the appointment of Contracting Officer Representatives (COR) and their duties, management of contract deficiency reports, and contract closeout, PIEE gives users tools to effectively manage awards throughout their lifecycle.

LEARN ABOUT COR

LEARN ABOUT PIEE

Property Management

PIEE plays a central role in the management of government property through the Government Furnished Property (GFP) Attachment, property transfers, and property loss processes. The IUID Registry within PIEE is used by the Department of Defense to store information about high value assets.

LEARN ABOUT GFP

LEARN ABOUT IUID

Purchase Card

The Department of Defense's Purchase Card Program leverages PIEE to facilitate the formal appointment of all roles. PIEE also serves as a single sign on point for access to the Bank System (AxOL) and the Data Mining Solution (IOD).

LEARN ABOUT PURCHASE CARD

Reporting and Document Retrieval

PIEE has a robust set of document retrieval and reporting tools within the environment starting with the ability to lookup contracts and moving to more advanced analytics and reports in one of the reporting features.

LEARN ABOUT REPORTING (PDF)

Requirements

At the start of any procurement is a requirement. PIEE allows users to write requirements in tools that are Purchase Request Data Standard (PRDS) compliant.

LEARN ABOUT PIEE

LEARN ABOUT PRDS

Solicitation Portal

The PIEE Solicitation Portal provides Industry with access to view details of many of DoD’s contract opportunities. The tool allows vendors to gain access to opportunity details, attachment data, and submit offers electronically.

Mirë se vini në faqen zyrtare të internetit të Prokurimit Publik të Kosovës e cila është e krijuar si Portal i Prokurimit Publik në të cilën do të gjinden të gjitha informacionet relevante që kanë të bëjnë me fushën e prokurimit publik në Kosovë.

                    

KRPP sipas Ligjit për Prokurim Publik të Kosovës Nr.04/L-042, është përgjegjëse për zhvillimin, funksionimin dhe mbikqyrjen e përgjithshme të sistemit të prokurimit publik në Kosovë, dhe i ushtron funksionet që i ipen nga ky ligj.
          
 
Njëra ndër funksionet që i janë dhënë KRPP-së me ligj është që të krijojë dhe mirëmbajë faqen informative në internet që i ofron publikut qasje të pakufizuar për të gjitha informacionet që kanë të bëjnë me prokurimin publik në Kosovë.

observed.title: e-GP Platform - e-GP System
observed.head:
Log In
e-GP System
e-GP Platform is a web-based, collaborative system to facilitate the full lifecycle of a tendering process, for both buyers and suppliers. It offers a secure, interactive, dynamic environment for procurements of any nature, complexity or value, enforcing (where appropriate) and encouraging recognised best practices.

e-GP Platform supports the process of procuring works, services and supplies electronically. Different public procurement procedures are supported for both one-off or repetitive purchases through several dedicated sub-modules providing facilities for user registration, tender notification, bid preparation and submission, online bid evaluation, contract awarding, creation and management of catalogue-based information, placement of electronic purchase orders, electronic Invoicing and order tracking.
